'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings]]
****At least 21 [[Palestinians]] are killed in a [[human stampede|crowd crush]] at a [[Gaza Humanitarian Foundation]] (GHF) site in the [[Gaza Strip]]. The GHF attributed the stampede to armed agitators, while [[Hamas]] and Palestinian eyewitnesses said that [[Israel]]i soldiers sprayed people with pepper gas and opened fire. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/16/at-least-21-people-killed-in-stampede-suffocation-at-ghf-site-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-backed-gaza-humanitarian-foundation-says-20-people-killed-crush-2025-07-16/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]], [[Southern Syria clashes (July 2025-present)|Southern Syria clashes]]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] bombs the [[Hay'at al-Arkan|Syrian Defense Ministry headquarters]] and the [[Presidential Palace, Damascus|presidential palace]] in [[Damascus]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/7/16/live-israel-bombs-gaza-syria-as-alarm-grows-over-malnourished-children (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israeli-strike-reported-on-syrias-presidential-palace/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***Israeli forces launch an attack on the [[Druze in Syria|Druze]] city of [[Suwayda]] in [[As-Suwayda Governorate]], [[Syria]], after scattered clashes continue in spite of the [[ceasefire]] announcement by the [[Syrian Armed Forces]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/16/israel-bombs-syrias-druze-city-of-suwayda-hours-after-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/syria-druze-clashes-sweida-44585d1d58ddcdd224e9573ca94767b0 (AP)]
*[[Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**The [[Bangladesh Armed Forces|Bangladesh military]] clashes with supporters of ousted [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|prime minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] in [[Gopalganj District, Bangladesh|Gopalganj District]], leading to four deaths and many others injured. [https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-clashes-hasina-students-1e58562a6c9e766c760af9b577189504 (AP)]
*[[Herder-farmer conflicts in Nigeria]]
**At least 27 people are killed when unidentified gunmen attack a village in [[Riyom]], [[Plateau State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cvg8m7rjy51o (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-attack-gunmen-6fc2ceb4775a56e6219295e53dbec8ed (AP)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Spillover of the Somali civil war]]
**[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab militants]] claim to have killed three [[Kenya Defence Forces|Kenyan soldiers]] patrolling a road in the east of the country near the Somali border. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/blast-kills-three-kenyan-soldiers-road-near-somali-border-2025-07-16/ (Reuters)]

**[[Torrential rain]]s in [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]], kill at least 63 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gkygz3vg5o (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***The [[Ethiopia]]n [[National Intelligence and Security Service (Ethiopia)|National Intelligence and Security Service]] detains dozens of suspected [[Somalia]]n [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|Islamic State militants]], whom it alleges were trained and deployed to conduct operations throughout the country, especially in the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains of the [[Bari, Somalia|Bari region]] in [[Puntland]]. *[[Opioid epidemic in the United States]], [[Anti-fentanyl legislation in the United States]]
**[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] signs into law the HALT Fentanyl Act, reclassifying all [[fentanyl]]-related substances, including [[synthetic drug]]s, as [[Controlled Substances Act#Schedule I|Schedule I]] controlled substances. [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/5404826-trump-signs-fentanyl-legislation/ (''The Hill'')]

**The [[Russia]]n [[State Duma]] introduces new legislation that introduces fines for searching for prohibited material online. The legislation is passed on July 22.
